[[File:Dredd The Card Game logo.png|thumb|Original Judge Dredd: The Card Game logo.]]
'''Judge Dredd: The Card Game''' is a card game published by Round Table Productions in 1999.<ref name="drebbb" /> The [[TCGMix]] playtest covers the base set.<ref name="catalog" />

== History ==

The original rulebook credits Simon Lucas for the original concept and Robin Elliott, Lucas and Jeremy Norton for game design. It credits Elliott for the logos and game icons.<ref name="dreddrules" />

== Gameplay ==

Teams earn Prestige by solving crimes. At the victory check, 20 Prestige or five Commendations wins the game. Containing all four Dark Judges wins immediately.<ref name="dreddrules" />

== Online play ==

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/dredd/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-dredd-tcg">[https://tcgmix.com/dredd/ Play Dredd TCG], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107194406/https://tcgmix.com/dredd/ Internet Archive].</ref>
